summary: Verified bug fix for PlanOp planning generator. All 8 targeted pytest tests pass (100%). generate_planning and reschedule endpoints correctly honor per-contract [start_date, deadline] windows, produce skipped array with 'deadline_expired' or 'deadline_reached', respect payload.start_from when start_date is missing, keep multi-contract windows separated, and enforce max_per_month within deadline bounds.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >2000 lines; consider splitting into modules (planning, invoice, ai, email) for maintainability.
generate_planning has deep nested while-loops for deadline/max_per_month; readable but complex - consider extracting a _advance_cursor helper.
In test suite, clean_state fixture wipes all user data; safe because this is a single-user personal app with a dedicated test session, but should never be run against production data.
seed_data_creation: Each test uses clean_state fixture to wipe & seed fresh TEST_ prefixed clients/contracts per scenario.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Use /app/backend/tests/test_planning_deadline.py as regression. Test session token is stored in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (may need refresh if >7 days old).
